reason: B is more physically plausible because it does not assume formation of an L1₂ phase in an essentially BCC Hf–Zr–Ti–Ta chemistry; A imports an FCC/L1₂ mechanism from Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni evidence that is not transferable to this alloy. B remains weak because the precipitate phase and processing window are unspecified and it cites no refractory-alloy evidence, but those deficiencies are more tractable than A’s likely incompatible phase premise.
